Die by the Sword, 1998: P166 + a 3Dfx card is the recommended spec; the disc's die\ folder IS the game (no installer) and it runs disc-free with SrcPath '.' and -nocd - verified in the W98BUILD VM 2026-10-01 (scripts/fleet/stage-win9x.py).

Rebellion engine, Direct3D only - there is no software renderer, so a 3D accelerator is mandatory rather than optional. REQUIRES MMX (measured 2026-08-30): avp.exe carries 1126 MMX-register references in emms-bounded blocks - its own rasteriser - and exactly ONE cpuid instruction in the whole binary, i.e. a single startup capability check rather than the per-function dispatch a title with a fallback path shows. THE ENGINE AND MENUS RUN; NO LEVEL LOADS - SINGLE PLAYER INCLUDED - without the retail disc's check being satisfied: every map (console 'map', '+map', '+newgame', single player and deathmatch alike) raises 'WON Error! Please insert the SOF CD and try again.' Re-measured 2026-09-28 on .124 (V5 6000, our clean-room stack: menus render at 1280x960, 'map nyc1' and 'map dm/nycdm1' both stop at that box). A mounted SOF-labelled retail image did not satisfy it on .143 or .246 (2026-08-31), so this title declares no disc_mount capability - that would only suppress the icon on .123.

Dark Engine. Direct3D or software renderer. XP-ONLY, MEASURED FROM THE PE HEADERS 2026-08-30: Thief2.exe carries MajorSubsystemVersion 5.0 and the tree ships D3DX9_43.dll and msvcr90.dll, i.e. this is the NewDark build. Windows 98's loader refuses a 5.0 subsystem outright. NewDark also REMOVED the software renderer - the engine's own strings are all Direct3D - so the gpu_feature_level here is correct and stays, unlike the software-capable titles it was wrongly copied onto.

DirectX 8.1. Its own startup dialog offers a D3D Hardware T&L acceleration mode and that is what it selected on a GeForce2 GTS; verified in-game there at 800x600x32, so the tnl floor is measured, not quoted. SafeDisc 2.51.020 - the tree ships the disc image and the launcher mounts it, BUT A MOUNT ALONE IS NOT ENOUGH: Daemon Tools SafeDisc emulation must also be enabled on the box (a tray setting; DT 3.47 stores its config as an encrypted blob so it cannot be set from the registry). With emulation off the game fails with "There is a problem with your game installation", which looks like a broke
Geo-Mod engine, Direct3D or OpenGL. The launcher mounts a disc image.

Croteam Serious Engine 1. Published minimum is a Pentium 233 MMX with 64 MB and an 8 MB 3D card; the engine has an OpenGL and a Direct3D renderer and NO software rasteriser, so a machine with no 3D pipeline cannot run it - gpu_feature_level 'fixed', not 'none'. THE DISC REQUIREMENT IS PER SHORTCUT, NOT PER TITLE. SeriousSam.exe checks for Install\Bin\SeriousSam.exe on a DRIVE_CDROM volume (plain GetDriveTypeA + fopen - no SafeDisc, no secdrv, so DAEMON Tools 3.47 satisfies it), but DedicatedServer.exe has no such check at all.
